usage: Append the matching profile's `rules` into 01-architecture/rules.md and its `layers` into architecture.md. Wire every `fitness` entry into CI before the rule is considered enforced. A rule with no enforcer is a suggestion.

flutter-riverpod.label: Flutter + Riverpod
flutter-riverpod.layers: UI widget -> Riverpod controller -> repository -> service/data source. A widget MUST NOT reach past the controller.
rules: MUST use `const` constructors for immutable widgets.
MUST hold cross-widget state in a Riverpod provider. `setState` MUST NOT carry state beyond a single widget.
Widgets MUST NOT import data-source packages (firebase, dio, sqflite) directly; go through a repository.
State classes MUST be immutable. Mutable public fields MUST NOT be exposed.
File naming: pages end `_page.dart`, controllers `_controller.dart`, repositories `_repository.dart`.
fitness: import_lint or a custom Dart import linter failing the build when lib/**/presentation imports a data-source package

nextjs-app-router.label: Next.js App Router
nextjs-app-router.layers: Server Component -> data client -> API. Client Components render only; they hold no secrets and no direct data access.
rules: Secrets MUST NOT appear in Client Components or in NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables.
Data fetching MUST happen in Server Components or Server Actions.
A Client Component MUST NOT import a server-only module; mark those with `import 'server-only'`.
Arbitrary style values (h-[37px], inline hex) MUST NOT be authored; use design tokens from 02-brand/design-tokens.md.
Every page MUST declare its `dynamic` / revalidate behaviour explicitly.
fitness: eslint-plugin-boundaries or dependency-cruiser rule: app/**/client-* MUST NOT reach server modules
grep gate in CI failing on NEXT_PUBLIC_ names matching /(SECRET|KEY|TOKEN|PASSWORD)/

nestjs-graphql.label: NestJS + GraphQL
nestjs-graphql.layers: resolver -> service -> repository. Resolvers hold no business logic.
rules: Resolvers MUST NOT contain business logic; they delegate to a service.
Every mutation MUST take an input DTO carrying class-validator decorators.
Entity fields MUST NOT be exposed without an explicit @Field().
Generated SDL MUST NOT be hand-edited; change the code-first definition and regenerate.
A module MUST NOT import another module's repository directly; cross-module access goes through the owning service.
fitness: dependency-cruiser: src/**/resolvers MUST NOT import src/**/repositories
CI step regenerating SDL and failing on a non-empty git diff

firebase.label: Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Functions, FCM)
firebase.layers: Clients may read/write Firestore directly, gated by Security Rules. Privileged writes go through Functions.
rules: Security rules MUST deny by default. `allow read, write: if true` MUST NOT be committed in any environment.
A security rule MUST NOT be weakened to make a test pass.
The Admin SDK service-account JSON MUST NOT enter the repository, a client bundle, or any NEXT_PUBLIC_/VITE_ variable.
Every rule change MUST ship with an emulator test asserting both the allowed and the denied case.
Collection-group and denormalisation decisions MUST be recorded as an ADR before implementation.
fitness: @firebase/rules-unit-testing against the emulator in CI, with assertFails on the unauthenticated and wrong-owner cases
secret scanner (gitleaks/trufflehog) as a pre-commit hook and a CI job

node-clean-architecture.label: Node/TypeScript Clean Architecture
node-clean-architecture.layers: domain <- usecases <- infra / interfaces. Imports point inward only.
rules: domain/ MUST NOT import from any other layer.
usecases/ MUST NOT import concrete infrastructure; depend on interfaces.
Operational failures MUST return a typed Result<T, E>; raw exceptions MUST NOT cross a layer boundary.
`any` and unchecked type assertions MUST NOT be authored.
Monetary values MUST use integer minor units, never floating point.
fitness: dependency-cruiser forbidden rules per layer, severity error

laravel.label: Laravel / PHP
rules: Controllers MUST NOT contain business logic; delegate to an Action or Service class.
Request payloads MUST be validated in a Form Request, never inline in the controller.
Raw SQL string concatenation MUST NOT be authored; use the query builder with bindings.
Migrations MUST be reversible; a destructive migration requires an ADR.
N+1 queries MUST be prevented with explicit eager loading on list endpoints.
fitness: PHPStan level 6+ or Psalm in CI
deptrac layer ruleset failing the build on a boundary violation

generic.label: Stack-agnostic baseline
generic.layers: State the layers, their allowed import direction, and which store owns which entity. Vague layer names without import rules are not architecture.
rules: Typecheck, tests, and the architecture check MUST pass before a task is marked [x].
A dependency MUST NOT be added without an ADR.
Secrets MUST NOT appear in any file under docs/ or in committed config.
A test MUST NOT be weakened or deleted to make a build pass.
Generated artefacts MUST NOT be hand-edited; change the source and regenerate.
fitness: a layer/import linter appropriate to the language, wired to fail the build
a secret scanner on every commit
